entries.back_en: "I'm hungry. But nobody can eat until Chino gets back."
entries.note: 'none of us'->'ninguem' slightly broadens but fine.

entries.back_en: "Did you manage to get there? Maybe I should've told you to go to the inn, huh?"
"If you found him, why aren't you chasing after him!? What do you think I hired you for, huh? It's so hard to find good help these days..."
entries.note: Meaning preserved; accent quirk not replicated but acceptable.

entries.back_en: "Heh heh... Did you find the princess?"
"What do you want? I don't need bodyguards right now."
entries.note: Broken-English style lost but sense intact.

entries.back_en: "I need to keep an eye on Chino so he doesn't cause too much trouble! After all, he's my brother!"
"Once again, sorry for all the trouble Chino caused. I hope you can find the Princess soon. We'll pray for you."
entries.note: 'remember you in our prayers'->'rezar por voces' close paraphrase, acceptable.
